# adapter-static

`adapter-static` allows you to prerender your entire SvelteKit app as a collection of static files, rather than dynamically server-rendering it. This is useful for static site hosting where no Node.js (or other) server runtime is available, such as GitHub Pages or a plain static file server behind nginx.

Install with `npm i -D @sveltejs/adapter-static` and configure it in `svelte.config.js`.
